flags.name: -size <float>
flags.description: sets size in pixels

flags.name: -range <float, float>
flags.description: sets minimum and maximum values

flags.name: -bgcolor <list>
flags.description: sets background color in hexdecimal or RGB list

flags.name: -fgcolor <list>
flags.description: sets foreground color in hexdecimal or RGB list

flags.name: -arccolor <list>
flags.description: sets the arc color of the knob

flags.name: -arc <float>
flags.description: non zero sets to arc drawing mode

flags.name: -arcstart <float>
flags.description: sets arc start value, no float sets current

flags.name: -nosquare
flags.description: doesn't draw the square background

flags.name: -angle <float>
flags.description: sets angular range value in degrees

flags.name: -offset <float>
flags.description: sets angular offset in degrees

flags.name: -circular <float>
flags.description: non zero sets to circular dragging mode

flags.name: -jump
flags.description: sets to jump on click mode

flags.name: -discrete
flags.description: sets to discrete mode

flags.name: -steps <float>
flags.description: sets number of steps (0 for none)

flags.name: -number <float>
flags.description: sets number mode

flags.name: -numbersize <float>
flags.description: sets the size of the displayed number

flags.name: -numberpos <f, f>
flags.description: sets the position of the displayed number

flags.name: -send <symbol>
flags.description: sets send symbol

flags.name: -receive <symbol>
flags.description: sets receive symbol

flags.name: -param <symbol>
flags.description: sets a parameter for the knob

flags.name: -var <symbol>
flags.description: assigns a variable to the knob

flags.name: -log
flags.description: sets to logarithmic scaling

flags.name: -exp <float>
flags.description: sets exponential value

flags.name: -load <float>
flags.description: sets load value, no float sets current

flags.name: -savestate
flags.description: saves the current state

flags.name: -noloadbang
flags.description: doesn't send the value when loading the patch

flags.name: -readonly
flags.description: sets read-only mode

flags.name: -notheme
flags.description: doesn't follow the color theme

flags.name: -transparent
flags.description: sets to transparent background
